reported_status: Completed source-exposed internal review of the named conditional construction. The actual three-dimensional second-order dressing/full remainder, compulsory electric response, trap/source/preparation/readout and noise budgets remain unresolved. Tiny fixed source-window tails do not preserve strict O(g) asymptotics as g tends to zero. Missing companion audit/control files are not reconstructed; current numerical outputs are not replayed by this intake.

proof_availability.classification_scope: For the self-adjoint two-sector Hamiltonian H(g), an isolated finite native code at E, a domain-valid normalizable divided source (H_B-E)U1=-VP, and a domain-valid second dressing U2 give an exact residual of orders g^3 and g^4. Duhamel yields an O(|g|) code-isometry approximation to exp(-i tau K) at time hbar*tau/g^2, including reference-entangled inputs and finite-sequence telescoping. An exactly circular full-hyperfine rotation and magnetic parity supply a conditional finite-spin extension while retaining the deliberately open channel; its three-level nonaffine phase remains nonzero.
